newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed this afternoon in listless trade with most traders squaring off their books ahead of the long weekend, dealers said on Friday.
"There wasn't much activity in the market today," a local dealer said. "Traders were only squaring off their positions ahead of the long weekend," he added.
It is a public holiday in New York on Monday.
"There was no fresh incentives to spurn the market," he said.

In short dates, weekend was unchanged at 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent. Week-fixed eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent. Among longer dates, one-month and three-months were unchanged at 5-3/8 5-1/4 and 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, respectively.

Three-months and five-months eased 1/16 percentage point to a common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, six-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, nine-months remained at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent and twelve-months eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent.
